items.title: Why Elon Musk will keep funding Grok, no matter the cost
items.summary: In the Loop Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen sets the table for why he believes Elon Musk is willing to keep pouring money into his AI project, Grok, no matter the cost. Ahamadeen explains why he believes personal AI assistants will become the “most important and valuable layer” for how people interact with the broader digital world.

items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Brings CX Enterprise Coworker to Major AI Platforms
items.summary: Adobe (NasdaqGS: ADBE) introduced its CX Enterprise Coworker agentic AI into leading third party AI platforms from Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Databricks. The CX Enterprise Coworker is designed to help marketing teams coordinate customer experiences across multiple AI environments rather than only within Adobe's own suite. Global systems integrators and agencies are reported to be incorporating the CX Enterprise Coworker into large scale customer experience and marketing...
